module: "Vehicle-relative" free camera (disabled by default): a flying camera whose position is expressed in the vehicle's frame (ref/left/back nodes), so it accompanies the moving vehicle. Keyboard/mouse movement and look (speed x5 far from the vehicle), manual zoom, 10 memorizable position/rotation/FOV slots (shortcut keys, "Relative Camera" radial menu), attached point light (0 / 500 / 2500 / 5000 lm) and nearClip presets (level, 0.5 mm, 1 cm, 10 cm). Can be preinitialized by named slots defined in the jbeam (numbered elements with .name). Returns a constructor.
notes: Creates on demand a PointLight object 'relativecameralight' (canSave = false, radius 20 m) in scenetree.
If the ref/left/back nodes are missing, uses nodes 0, 1, 2 (debug log). After a vehicle model change, the camera is recomputed one frame later.
The extracted page says hotkey(modifier) but the code is hotkey(hotkey, modifier); modifier 0 = load the slot, 1 = save it. loadSlot accepts a slot number or name.
The light is turned off (storeLightInfo) when the camera loses focus and restored (restoreLightInfo) when it regains it.

C.desc: Relative mode. Fields: pos (vec3 vehicle frame), rot (vec3 degrees), slots, lightIntensity, nearClip (nil = level), manualzoom, camMaxDist.

init.desc: Default values (resetCameraOnVehicleReset = false, disabledByDefault, canUseVehicleTriggerCrosshair) then onVehicleCameraConfigChanged and reset.

onVehicleCameraConfigChanged.desc: Hook: guarantees refNodes (default 0,1,2) and schedules the camera recomputation.

_updateLight.desc: Applies an intensity (>= 0) to the camera light, creating it if needed.

intensity.desc: lumens; nil = keeps the current value

sendMenus.desc: Adds the quickAccess radial menu entries (light, nearClip, slots) while the camera has focus.

restoreLightInfo.desc: Restores the light stored by storeLightInfo.

storeLightInfo.desc: Stores the intensity and turns the light off.

saveSlot.desc: Saves position, rotation and FOV in the given slot.

loadSlot.desc: Loads a slot; UI message if empty.

hotkey.desc: Slot keyboard shortcut; ignored without focus.

rot.desc: x yaw, y pitch, z roll in degrees

setOffset.desc: Sets the camera position in the vehicle frame.

setMaxDistance.desc: Limits the distance from the ref node.

serialize.desc: State for video stream views: pos, rot, fov, light, nearClip.

listParams.desc: UI settings: light, nearClip, slots, fov.

setParam.desc: Changes light, nearClip, fov or slots (saves or loads the given slot).

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook: on focus gain, adds the menus and turns the light back on; on loss, turns the light off.

focused.desc: true if the mode takes focus

reset.desc: Returns to the initial position and rotation and recreates the smoothers.

update.desc: Integrates the inputs, moves the camera in the vehicle frame and writes data.res (pos, rot, nearClip); positions the light.

returns.desc: false if the nodes are degenerate, otherwise true
